title: PHC issues notices on KP governor's rule petitions, adjourns to Nov 10
detail: A two-member Peshawar High Court bench (Justices Ijaz Anwar and Muhammad Faheem Wali) issued notices to the federal and KP governments on petitions challenging the Oct 11 emergency and governor's rule, and adjourned the hearing until Nov 10. Petitioners, including PTI chairman Gohar Ali Khan and the TTAP alliance, argue provincial assembly approval was required but never obtained. The report does not mention any interim order.
